scoring_justification: Result-level compare; the checker cannot recompute the full HF simulation to obtain gold. Reference curves from paper figures are used with interpolated tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for total energy per particle vs coverage
hidden_assets.source_provenance: digitized from Fig. 5 of the paper (Phys. Rev. B 57, 13258) at selected coverages
hidden_assets.generation_method: read from the paper's published figure, approximating the curve with points that match the overall trend; values are consistent with the reference oracle solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published numerical results of the paper used as the reproduction target.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for effective mass vs coverage
hidden_assets.source_provenance: digitized from Fig. 4 of the paper (Phys. Rev. B 57, 13258) at selected coverages
hidden_assets.generation_method: read from the paper's published figure, approximating the decreasing curve with points consistent with the reference oracle solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published numerical results of the paper used as the reproduction target.

outputs.description: Total energy per particle as function of areal coverage. The checker compares the reported values to hidden gold values derived from the paper's Fig. 5 using a relative tolerance and monotonic trend check.

Effective mass as function of areal coverage. The checker compares the reported values to hidden gold values derived from the paper's Fig. 4 using a relative tolerance and a lower bound check (m* > 1.0 m_He).

output_contract.notes: The two scored tables must be produced from the same set of coverages. The HF simulation (process step) must be executed by the agent; no pre-solved wavefunctions or energy values are provided.
